about_the_game:
Prepare to embark on a new journey, test your reflexes and climb the levels! In this fast-paced survival game, you control a glowing orb, navigating through a mysterious, ever-changing world filled with dangerous obstacles and relentless enemies.

📦 What's included in this demo?

You’ll be able to enjoy the full Glow Journey gameplay experience, with one limitation: you can only progress up to level 5.

Leaderboards are also separate — only demo players appear there, and your scores won't carry over to the full version.

🚀 A Thrilling and Evolving Challenge

Each level is a challenge to the exit portal, but reaching it won’t be easy! Collect XP orbs to level up and choose from three powerful upgrades, including passive boosts and unique spells to enhance your survival.

⚡ No Attacks, Only Pure Evasion

There’s no fighting back—only your skills and instincts will keep you alive! The further you go, the tougher the enemies, the trickier the paths, and the faster your decisions must be.

🏆 Climb the Leaderboards

Compete against players worldwide! Your ranking is based on survival time, world difficulty, and XP collected. Can you go further than anyone else?

✨ Hypnotic World to Explore

Immerse yourself in a stunning neon universe of purples and violets, where every journey is unique and every move counts.

Dodge, adapt, and push your limits in Glow Journey! How far will you go? 🔮

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 7/10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 530 / NVIDIA GTX 750
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 / RX 570
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Glow Journey is a minimalist action-roguelike where you control an orb navigating a procedurally generated world. Dodge enemies and traps, collect XP, and choose powerful upgrades to survive longer and reach new levels in this fast-paced survival adventure.
